subject: general
question: A certain number of people are sitting in a row, facing north. K sits to the immediate left of G. L sits to the immediate right of P. P is fourth to the right of G. L is fourth to the left of H. If no other person is sitting in the row, what is the total number of persons seated?
solution:
**Given**: A certain number of people are sitting in a row, facing north. 

1) K sits to the immediate left of G. 

2)L sits to the immediate right of P. 

3) P is fourth to the right of G. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c923e96509dd1b081778633b8d9e2209762f1447dfc836007b0379322b342ffe.png] 

4) L is fourth to the left of H.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c966663c99119564b253b6febb6bfee50eda29ed3543bc64048e07171954d402.png] 

So, **total 11 persons are seated in the row**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
